name: Zone 2 · Orchard
notes:
Hairpin fruit forest (phase 1, now to end of Nov 2026). The irrigated core orchard above the house, with the three contour swale rows.
Water: treated water by sub-surface drip under mulch (check the approved area), plus rain. Keep it off anything eaten from the ground.
Trees: the mature 2–3 m trees – about 10 citrus, custard apple, white and black mulberry, moringa (keep moringa low, southern end, away from the solar panels).
Guild under each citrus: comfrey, sweet potato as living mulch, pigeon pea as nurse (chop at 1.5 m), garlic chives.
Solar array edge: pineapples and low ground cover inside the vine fence; nothing tall.
Lower edge above the 1.8 m drop: lomandra and pineapples only.
Plan: Bright Tree planting calendar and phasing (Oct 2026).
